notes.n4.hyper: The big US clouds plus Oracle hold most AI compute; China has its own top tier (Alibaba, Huawei, Tencent, Baidu, Volcano Engine).
notes.n4.neo: Neoclouds scaled on multi-billion contracts from Microsoft, Meta, OpenAI and Anthropic; CoreWeave and Nebius public, Nscale filed for IPO Sep-Oct 2026, Lambda preparing.
notes.n4.sovereign: Countries fund in-country compute via telcos and national champions (IndiaAI Mission, Humain, G42/Core42, EuroHPC AI Factories).
notes.n4.serverless: Per-second GPU platforms serve developers; consolidation under way (Cloudflare buying Replicate).
notes.n4.onprem: OEM 'AI factory' bundles co-engineered with NVIDIA dominate private AI.
notes.n4.market: Mix of centralised spot/forward markets (SF Compute, Vast.ai) and crypto-based DePIN networks.
notes.n4.finance: Shift in 2026 from bilateral GPU-backed debt to market infrastructure: ICE+Ornn and CME+Silicon Data compute futures, plus on-chain lenders (USD.AI) and tokenised GPU ownership (Compute Labs).
notes.n4.orch: GPU virtualisation and pooling (Thunder Compute, Juice Labs, VirtAI OrionX, HAMi, Liqid) and checkpoint/migration (Cedana, MemVerge) now form a distinct cluster from schedulers.
notes.n4.finops: Generic FinOps vendors are adding GPU and AI-API cost views; few are GPU-native yet.
notes.n4.ops: GPU failure rates make health checks and fabric monitoring a differentiator; neocloud reliability is now rated independently (ClusterMAX).
notes.n4.offtake: computeprices.com tracks ~$1.05T across 21 disclosed lab-cloud deals (scale indicator, not audited)
notes.n4.confidential: Hyperscalers bundle GPU TEEs; independents being absorbed (Anthropic-OPAQUE, Oct 2026)
notes.n4.access: Mix of national research compute (NAIRR, AIRR, EuroHPC, IndiaAI) and vendor startup credits
notes.n4.stack: Thin but growing B2B layer: Rafay, hosted·ai, Ori, Armada Bridge (ex-aarna.ml), Mirantis k0rdent, OpenNebula sell the control plane; Netris adds network multi-tenancy; Solvimon, Monetize360, Evergent, OpenMeter add metering and billing.

entries.access: Free spec; FOCUS-format billing exports from major clouds
entries.one_liner: Common schema for cloud, SaaS and AI billing data across providers
entries.note: FOCUS 1.3 launched; 1.2 widely supported by vendors

entries.name: Google TPU Research Cloud
entries.access: Researchers apply for free Cloud TPU quota
entries.one_liner: Free Cloud TPU access for researchers who agree to publish and share their work
entries.note: Corporate programme rather than government; included as free access route

entries.name: Gramine
entries.access: Packages; run unmodified apps in Intel SGX enclaves
entries.one_liner: Library OS running unmodified Linux applications inside SGX enclaves

entries.name: HAMi
entries.access: Helm install; supports NVIDIA and Chinese accelerators
entries.one_liner: CNCF sandbox project for heterogeneous GPU/NPU sharing and virtualisation on Kubernetes
entries.note: Backed by Dynamia AI

entries.name: KAI Scheduler
entries.access: Helm install on Kubernetes GPU clusters
entries.one_liner: GPU-aware Kubernetes scheduler with quotas, fractional GPUs and gang scheduling
entries.note: Open-sourced by NVIDIA from its Run:ai stack in 2025; now a CNCF sandbox project

entries.name: Karpenter
entries.access: Helm install; providers for AWS, Azure and others
entries.one_liner: Just-in-time node autoscaler that right-sizes and consolidates capacity, incl. GPU nodes

entries.name: Keylime
entries.access: Install agent and verifier; TPM-based remote attestation
entries.one_liner: Remote boot and runtime integrity attestation using TPMs
entries.note: Licence changed from BSD-2-Clause to Apache-2.0

entries.name: Kubernetes
entries.access: Managed (EKS/GKE/AKS) or self-host
entries.one_liner: Container orchestrator that is now the default control plane for GPU clusters
entries.note: Dynamic Resource Allocation (GPU-aware device claims) GA in v1.34 (Aug 2025)

entries.name: Kueue
entries.access: kubectl/Helm install on any Kubernetes cluster
entries.one_liner: Kubernetes-native job queueing, quotas and fair sharing for batch and AI workloads

entries.name: NVIDIA DCGM
entries.access: Install packages on GPU nodes
entries.one_liner: Data Center GPU Manager: health checks, diagnostics and telemetry for NVIDIA GPUs

entries.name: NVIDIA GPU Operator
entries.access: Helm install on Kubernetes
entries.one_liner: Automates drivers, device plugin, MIG and monitoring for GPUs on Kubernetes

entries.name: NVIDIA nvtrust
entries.access: Clone tools/SDK for GPU confidential-computing mode
entries.one_liner: Attestation and tooling for confidential computing on NVIDIA GPUs

entries.name: NVSentinel
entries.access: Helm install on Kubernetes GPU clusters
entries.one_liner: Detects and auto-remediates GPU faults on Kubernetes nodes

entries.name: OpenCost
entries.access: Helm install on Kubernetes
entries.one_liner: Vendor-neutral Kubernetes cost allocation incl. GPU, CPU, memory and cloud bills

entries.name: OpenStack
entries.access: Distros (Canonical, Red Hat) or self-deploy
entries.one_liner: Open cloud platform behind many sovereign, telco and GPU neocloud deployments

entries.name: Prometheus
entries.access: Self-host; de facto metrics backend for GPU exporters
entries.one_liner: CNCF metrics system, standard for scraping GPU exporter data

entries.name: Ray
entries.access: pip install ray; KubeRay for Kubernetes
entries.one_liner: Distributed compute engine for scaling training, data processing and serving across GPUs
entries.note: Donated by Anyscale to the PyTorch Foundation Oct 2025

entries.name: SkyPilot
entries.steward: SkyPilot project (UC Berkeley Sky Computing Lab origin)
entries.access: pip install skypilot; launch on many clouds and Kubernetes
entries.one_liner: Runs AI jobs across clouds/Kubernetes, picking cheapest available GPUs

entries.name: Slurm
entries.access: Packages or source; Slinky operator for Kubernetes
entries.one_liner: Dominant HPC/AI cluster workload manager used for large training runs
entries.note: NVIDIA acquired SchedMD Dec 2025, committing to keep Slurm open source

entries.name: Sovereign Cloud Stack (SCS)
entries.access: Open standards + reference stack; provider certification
entries.one_liner: Open, certifiable standards and reference stack for interoperable sovereign clouds in Europe
entries.note: Federally funded build phase ended (final report Apr 2025); standards continue under the OSBA forum

entries.name: Volcano
entries.access: Helm install on Kubernetes
entries.one_liner: Batch scheduler for AI/HPC on Kubernetes with gang scheduling and topology awareness
